definition.def: If there is scope for a particular kind of behaviour or activity, people have the opportunity to behave in this way or do that activity.
examples: He believed in giving his staff scope for initiative. [+ for]
Banks had increased scope to develop new financial products.

definition.def: The scope of an activity, topic, or piece of work is the whole area which it deals with or includes.
examples: Mr Dobson promised to widen the organisation's scope of activity. [+ of]

examples.sentence: Implicit theories provide a framework that is useful in defining the general scope of a phenomenon - especially a not-well-understood phenomenon.
